requiredFindings.problem: The direct transport discards the already received HTTP status on overflow/error/abort and produces RESPONSE(status) only after end. A known401 response with65537 bytes yields OVERFLOW, so orchestration returns ASK_REMOTE_INVALID, settles DELIVERY_UNKNOWN, leaves the local circuit open and never attempts durable pause. The same401 with a small body correctly returns ASK_REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE, settles UPSTREAM_REJECTED and closes/pauses. An unending or failed error body likewise loses an already known status. This violates the fixed non-200 mapping and mandatory401/403 configuration-fault circuit.
